newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel pushed higher by futures,tight supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel pushed higher by futures,tight supply.

text.p: NWE jet fuel pushed higher on Thursday on surging benchmark IPE futures and firmer premiums, traders said.
Traders said premiums on fob cargoes had edged up to Sept IPE +$26/+$28.

"Supply is pretty tight and with refiners so tied up with getting ready for the changeover to 0.05 percent sulphur in October there's little sign they will be able to produce more jet," one trader said.
The Mediterranean continued to be tight with premiums assessed at quotes fob Med +$8/+$10.
